integrity: Complete exact proof, standalone standard-library checker, explicit rational witness; historical priority provisional.
scientific_limitations: Uniform fixed-cardinality taxon rarefaction on rooted strictly ultrametric positive-length trees; the full phase inequalities apply to a specified five-leaf topology only. No claim of independent validation, general five-tip shape classification, or empirical prevalence. General variance formula from Nipperess and Matsen is prior work.
title: Sharp five-taxon onset and a phase region for bimodal ultrametric phylogenetic-rarefaction variance
